texts.orig: Besides diabetes and age, only PTH and phosphate had significant direct effects on MS. The effect of T2DM was by far the strongest, while the estimated direct effect of PTH was 0.36 (95% CrI [0.15,0.57]). This value implies that 1 SD increase in PTH (2.3 pmolll) results in an increase of 0.36 in the odds of MS. Due to significant gender difference, this direct effect of PTH on MS was significant for women only.

Our analysis on morbidly obese subjects suggests possible mediating role of PTH in the association between MS and various demographic variables and biomarkers.
